test.create_query: CREATE TABLE text_index_wide_column ( id UInt64, message String, payload String, INDEX idx message TYPE text(tokenizer = splitByNonAlpha) GRANULARITY 1 ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192, index_granularity_bytes = 0, min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO text_index_wide_column SELECT number, concat('common w', toString(cityHash64(number) % 20000), if(number % 8192 = 0 AND intDiv(number, 8192) % 2 = 0, ' needle', ''), if(number % 8192 = cityHash64(intDiv(number, 8192), 'pos') % 8192 AND intDiv(number, 8192) % 2 = 0, ' spread', '')), arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> lower(hex(sipHash128(number, i))), range(32)), '-') FROM numbers(1000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 8
test.query: SELECT id, payload FROM text_index_wide_column WHERE hasToken(message, 'needle') FORMAT Null
SELECT argMax(payload, id) FROM text_index_wide_column WHERE hasToken(message, 'needle') FORMAT Null
SELECT id, payload FROM text_index_wide_column WHERE hasToken(message, 'needle') AND payload LIKE '%abc%' FORMAT Null
SELECT id, payload FROM text_index_wide_column WHERE hasToken(message, 'needle') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT id, payload FROM text_index_wide_column WHERE hasToken(message, 'spread') FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM text_index_wide_column WHERE hasToken(message, 'needle') FORMAT Null
SELECT id FROM text_index_wide_column WHERE hasToken(message, 'needle') FORMAT Null
SELECT id, payload FROM text_index_wide_column WHERE hasToken(message, 'common') FORMAT Null
